body.x: Second Ground will showcase asports recording video system at CES 2019, the world's largest technologyexhibition in Las Vegas, USA, from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri).

Participating in this exhibition,Second Ground not only professionally records and analyzes intramural sports,but also launched a variety of services to meet the needs of sports people insociety. Through the record input platform, we are trying to provide highquality services such as real time text relay service, record analysis service,and video relay service for social sports records. It has been promoting thesocialization of sports as a platform to grow as a platform for recording andsharing information of sports people around the world.

Features of sports record videosystem include: ▲ simple and easy input system ▲ data is saved instantly byinterlocking with the server ▲ platform for advanced analysis of inputtedrecord in real time, , Etc. ○ The company has its own YouTube streaming systemfor social sports relay broadcasting ▶ Input information is displayed on thescreen score board and the situation can be relayed through voice, It ispossible to use several cameras in the video relay system, and it is possibleto switch the screen automatically with the camera installed in the properplace according to the recording input.

The 21 companies are available at the SouthPlaza Design & Source Showcase Zones in the showroom.
